## CLI-Anything scheduled feeds -- READ THIS FIRST

**What this workflow does, and no more:** on a schedule, runs one read-only recipe from each
of the five browser-backed CLI-Anything harnesses that has no Mac task of its own yet (Lofty
and Zoho already have `lofty-crm-sync` / `zoho-crm-sync`; CRMLS has no harness by design; see
`$S/r9/C2-routing.md`). Each command's stdout+stderr is written to its own file under
`~/.cli-anything-feeds/n8n-output/`. Nothing here calls a vendor's write endpoint, sends
anything, or touches a client record.

**Where this stops, on purpose:** turning that output into the dashboard's `ratesSnapshot` /
`liveFeeds` docs is `read_db`/`write_db` work -- an Anthropic-side Claude Code tool call, not
something an n8n Execute Command or HTTP node can reach. This workflow does NOT invent a
second path into those docs. The existing `cli-anything-feeds` Mac task
(`integrations/mac-task-specs.md` §7) is the one documented store-write path today, for the
`publicfeeds` recipes; extending it (or a sibling task) to also read this workflow's output
files is a `proposal` in this round's hand-back, not built here.

**Every command below fails cleanly by design until Steven has:** installed the CLI-Anything
hub + harnesses on the Mac (`MAC-SETUP.sh`), signed into the DOMShell Chrome extension for
that target, and (SkySlope/zipForms only) set `CLI_ANYTHING_ECC_REVIEWED_AT`. In this round's
cloud sandbox none of the five console scripts exist on PATH at all (they are Mac-only
tools) -- every Execute Command node below returns a nonzero exit / "command not found",
which is the correct, honest failure for this environment. `continueOnFail` is set on each
node so one harness's absence never blocks the other four.
